answer: Price each identity to a scarce external hardware anchor that signs a fresh proof every epoch, and weight standing only after already-established peers in SEPARATE funding clusters co-sign audited work. A sybil fleet forked from one wallet is a mirror of a single key: its vouches merely echo back onto themselves, never spanning distinct clusters, so trust never ripens over the long voyage of epochs. Honest roots pay one anchor once; a farm must forge a distinct anchor per head, so cost climbs linearly with fakes.
